# acme

> Nx monorepo, mixed Angular + React. Multi-context: each app/lib owns its own CONTEXT.md glossary and docs/adr/.

Generated by `tools/generate-llms-txt.mts` (`npm run llms`) — do not edit by hand; `npm run llms:check` fails on drift.

Multi-context repo: each app/lib below owns its own `CONTEXT.md` (glossary) and `docs/adr/`
(architectural decisions). There is no repo-root `CONTEXT.md`.

Dependencies between contexts: ng-table → Table.

## Contexts

- [ISSA Landing](apps/issa-landing/CONTEXT.md): Scroll-driven landing page + application wizard. ADRs: `apps/issa-landing/docs/adr/`.
- [ng-table](apps/ng-table/CONTEXT.md): Dark-only documentation and marketing site for NGP Table (`@acme/table`); does not implement the table itself. ADRs: `apps/ng-table/docs/adr/`.
- [Shared Design System](libs/shared/design-system/CONTEXT.md): Shared Angular UI components for the dropdown/autocomplete family. ADRs: `libs/shared/design-system/docs/adr/`.
- [Table](libs/shared/table/CONTEXT.md): Standalone `@acme/table` headless table primitive, extracted from Design System (ADR-0009). ADRs: `libs/shared/table/docs/adr/`.

## Optional

- [AGENT.md - acme](AGENT.md): Tech stack, build and test commands, and the architecture map. Thin by design.
- [ADR-0001 — A generated `llms.txt` replaces the hand-written `CONTEXT-MAP.md`](docs/adr/0001-generated-llms-txt-replaces-context-map.md): Status: proposed.
- [DS Component Builder — Agent Status](docs/agents/agent-status.md): Which DS component-builder agents exist and which are still missing.
- [Domain Docs](docs/agents/domain.md): How the engineering skills consume this repo’s domain docs, ADRs and context map.
- [Issue tracker: GitHub](docs/agents/issue-tracker.md): Issues live as GitHub issues; conventions and `gh` CLI usage.
- [Skill Workflow — Domain-Scoped Documentation](docs/agents/skill-component-workflow.md): The ticket-bundled to domain-scattered model skills follow when splitting outputs.
- [Ticket tracker: Local Markdown (domain-colocated)](docs/agents/ticket-tracker.md): Intake tickets live colocated with the domain they describe; conventions and file layout.
